item.title: WRECK WATCH: Top 5 crash-prone intersections in Hampton Roads
item.description: 10 On Your Side's WRECK WATCH is at the most dangerous intersections in Hampton Roads — the ones where the most crashes took place, based on 2024 data. Keith Nichols, a principal transportation engineer with the Hampton Roads Transportation Planning Organization, compiled Virginia Department of Transportation and the Department of Motor Vehicles data, at 10 On Your Side's request, to find those dangerous intersections.
